task_title: Add generic weapon anchors to mob sprite metadata and editor

plan_review.notes: Plan review (rubber-duck) identified 4 blocking issues: telegraph path missing weapon anchor; variant selection; manual weapon anchor pipeline survival; approve-from-store hydration. All 4 addressed in implementation: (1) enemyTelegraph.ts applies weapon anchor offset; (2) PhaserBridge uses pickGeneratedVariant with correct variantRoll; (3) run-pipeline.ts writes NN.anchor.weapon.json per-variant; (4) hydrateRunDirForApproveFromStore includes NN.anchor.weapon.json. Also corrected: weapon anchor not defaulted to hold; facing source uses velocity.x not shot direction.

rounds.notes: 4 findings: (1) zero-indexed mirroring comment in resolveWeaponAnchorWorldPos - added; (2) magic 64 in PhaserBridge - extracted to DEFAULT_GENERATED_FRAME_SIZE_PX constant; (3) resolveWeaponAnchorSidecar JSDoc @returns clause - added; (4) 8-param function grouping suggestion - addressed via inline documentation clarifying call-site semantics
All 4 concerns resolved. Typecheck and 8 unit tests green.
